mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO quiz_questions (quiz_id, concept_id, question, choices, answer_index, explanation) VALUES
(#{quizId}, #{q.conceptId}, #{q.question}, #{q.choices, javaType=java.util.List, typeHandler=com.vibenote.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, #{q.answerIndex}, #{q.explanation})
mapper.select: SELECT id, analysis_id, created_at FROM quizzes WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId}
SELECT z.id, z.analysis_id, z.created_at, a.user_id AS owner_id FROM quizzes z JOIN analyses a ON a.id = z.analysis_id WHERE z.id = #{quizId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, quiz_id, user_id, score, total, created_at FROM quiz_attempts WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: WITH my_answers AS ( SELECT ans.question_id, ans.selected_index, ans.is_correct, t.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ans.question_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC) AS rn, SUM(CASE WHEN ans.is_correct THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY ans.question_id) AS wrong_count FROM quiz_attempts t JOIN quiz_answers ans ON ans.attempt_id = t.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ) SELECT m.question_id, q.quiz_id, z.analysis_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.title), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.name), '')) AS analysis_title, q.concept_id, q.question, q.choices, q.answer_index, q.explanation, m.selected_index, m.wrong_count, m.created_at AS last_answered_at FROM my_answers m JOIN quiz_questions q ON q.id = m.question_id JOIN quizzes z ON z.id = q.quiz_id JOIN analyses a ON a.id = z.analysis_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = a.project_id WHERE m.rn = 1 AND NOT m.is_correct AND (a.user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_analyses ta JOIN team_members tm ON tm.team_id = ta.team_id AND tm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE ta.analysis_id = a.id))
mapper.select: ORDER BY last_answered_at DESC, m.question_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_attempts (quiz_id, user_id, score, total, created_at) VALUES (#{quizId}, #{userId}, #{score}, #{total}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO quiz_answers (attempt_id, question_id, selected_index, is_correct) VALUES
(#{attemptId}, #{a.questionId}, #{a.selectedIndex}, #{a.correct})
